extracted.intended_audience: educated general public and scientists interested in geology/chemical geology (readers of Popular Science Monthly)
extracted.subtask_description: A 19th-century popular-science article presenting a geological and chemical theory that saline (evaporite) mineral deposits originate from the evaporation of ancient seawaters, supported by experimental evaporation studies and comparisons with modern depositional environments (Rhone delta, Caspian Karabogaz, Dead Sea).
